messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: Service=kv-cache-pool-us-west-2 (sev=high). Alert: eviction-rate > 80% in az3 for 5m. PD: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 auto-created and routed to on-call. Escalation policy: infra-sre.

Devon: acked. I’m on it — jumping in to triage. @Maria can you pull the eviction traces?

Maria: pulling logs now. seeing steady kvcache evictions spikes at 11:06:22 -> 11:11:30. pods in az3 hitting 98% mem, OOM eviction churn.

Devon: copying metrics: `kvcache.evictions{az=\"az3\"}` (last 10m) -> 560, error-rate for generation endpoints up ~12%.

Lee: noticed some routed traffic still preferring az3 due to weighted routing. Preparing to flip fallback.

Tara: tagging Dedicated customers on az3 (cust-A, cust-B). Notified CSMs.

Devon: mitigation plan: (1) activate routing fallback to avoid az3, (2) scale up spare pool in az2/az1, (3) patch autoscaler to ignore transient evictions for 5m threshold. I’ll run steps 1+2 now.

Devon: running command: ```
# promote fallback routing away from az3
rtr apply --policy fallback-az --avoid az3 --reason "kv-cache evictions az3"
```

ops-bot: rtr apply accepted, policy fallback-az queued. Change-id: chg-20260314-77.

Maria: while that’s running, here’s a snippet from node logs in az3: ```
[11:07:10] kv_cache: evict key=ctx-4a9f size=2.3MB reason=oom
[11:07:12] scheduler: requeue request id=xyz latency=280ms
[11:08:01] kubelet: oom_kill process=redwood-runtime mem=91%
```

Devon: fallback policy applied; traffic weights adjusted: az3 -> 5%, az2 -> 60%, az1 -> 35%. Monitoring overflow.

Lee: provisioning extra instances in az2 now: `infra scale --pool=gpu-dedicated-us-west-2-az2 --count+4`

ops-bot: scale request accepted, job=scale-881. Estimated ready ~6m.

Maria: after fallback, 2min in, generation error-rate dropping to 5% for requests routed to az2. but some long-tail failures persist for requests still hitting az3.

Devon: applying autoscaler patch to reduce thrash: ```
kubectl -n infra patch hpa autoscaler-kv --patch '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300}}}}'
```

Jonathan: I’m taking handoff in 20 minutes for the overnight shift. If we’re still in fallback at handoff, I’ll continue mitigation.

Tara: customer impact update: cust-A saw 13% 5xx spike between 11:05-11:12. cust-B intermittent latency, no data loss. Notifying affected account reps.

Devon: PD note: acknowledging incident, activated fallback, scaling started, autoscaler stabilized. Assigned oncall: Jonathan for next shift.

pagerduty: PD12345 status: acknowledged by Devon at 11:13:02. Next escalation window in 15m.

Maria: confirming cache warmup in az2 after scale up — KV hit-rate improving. eviction-rate in az3 trending down slowly (now 40% in last 5m).

Lee: scaling finished: 4 new instances in az2 are ready. routing holding steady.

Jonathan: I’ve joined the thread. Thanks Devon — I’ll own the rest. Plan: keep fallback policy for 30m, watch eviction and error-rate, then gradually shift traffic back once evictions <10% for 10m.

Devon: leaving notes in PD and will follow up with a short post-incident runbook: root cause suspected memory leak in kvcache LRU recently rolled in v1.4.2. tagging eng-runtime.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: runbook-creation task created -> TASK-9876, owner=Devon, due=2026-03-15.

Tara: customer comms drafted. Will send update once Jon gives green.

Jonathan: acknowledged handoff. I’ll reopen if we see any regressions. :white_check_mark:

Devon: :thumbsup: good handoff. Good job team, keeping customers stable.

incident-bot: Logging thread summary: PD12345 | az3 kvcache evictions -> fallback activated -> scale-up az2 -> autoscaler stabilization -> handoff to Jonathan. Postmortem triage required.

pagerduty: PD12345 updated: status=acknowledged, assignee=Jonathan.

Jonathan: final check in — error-rate stabilized at 2.7% across customers, az3 eviction-rate now 8% (last 10m). I’m removing emergency fallback at 11:28:10 and will shift weights back slowly.

Lee: executing gradual rollback: `rtr apply --policy fallback-az --remove-avoid az3 --stepwise true`

ops-bot: rollback queued, change-id: chg-20260314-78.

Maria: monitoring post-rollback: no regression at +5m.

Jonathan: closing PD once metrics stable for 10m. Leaving follow-ups: eng-runtime to investigate leak, infra to add eviction alert thresholds per-az, and ops to update runbook.

Devon: thanks all. Logging post-incident tasks and will sync with eng-runtime tomorrow. :coffee:
